evidence_slice: Northumberland County Council's Strategic Housing Land Availability Assessment 2025 to 2040 identifies SHLAA Ref 0054, South of Ravensmount, Alnwick, as a 4.50 hectare greenfield Neighbourhood Plan housing allocation that is suitable, available and achievable, with an 11-15 year conclusion and total future yield of 70 dwellings. The National Data Library identifies Northumberland County Council as publisher, the Open Government Licence as the licence, and a public SHLAA FeatureServer; its SHLAA layer is an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer with a Reference field and supports geoJSON.
